blocks.content: To handle overflows such as the one we saw on the previous page, we introduce a method called splitting. Splitting consists of two steps:

items: Split the node around its median key.
Move the median key up to the parent node.

blocks.content: Now, the split node will result in two new nodes:

items: The left leaf node contains keys smaller than the median.
The right leaf node contains keys greater than the median.
